children: Upstream Bio announced pivotal Phase 3 plans for verekitug, including a 400mg subcutaneous dose every 12 weeks and two placebo‑controlled trials totaling ~1,500 patients.
Phase 3 to evaluate single high‑dose 400mg subcutaneous regimen administered every 12 weeks for both indications.
One placebo‑controlled pivotal trial in each indication enrolling ~1,500 patients across both studies.
Broad study populations with no baseline biomarker restrictions to assess efficacy across patients.
Primary endpoints: asthma—annualized exacerbation rate over 48 weeks; CRSwNP—co‑primary nasal polyp and nasal congestion score changes at 48 weeks.
Company remains on track to initiate both Phase 3 trials in Q1 2027 and, if supportive, could file BLAs aiming for potential launch as early as 2030.
